name: hcapp_processBulkPayment
description: Processes payments for multiple hashers at once. Accepts a comma-separated list of user UUIDs, parses them via STRING_SPLIT+TRY_CAST, upserts HasherEventMap records, cancels prior payments for those users, and inserts new payment records using a CURSOR loop. Token validated against just @deviceSecret (not compound like processPayment). After completion, calls nonApi_updateRunCountsForAllUsers and returns adHoc + syncEventAdminData.

parameters.name: userIdsWhoPaid
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of hasher UUIDs. VARCHAR (not NVARCHAR).

parameters.name: paymentType
parameters.description: 1=not paid, 2=free, 3=cash, 4=bank transfer, 5=cash other, 6=hash credit, 7=bank transfer other.

parameters.name: transactionTimestamp
parameters.description: Payment timestamp as string. Cast to DATETIME inside cursor loop.

rowsets.name: StandardErrors
rowsets.description: Standard error format. errorType=2 for null userId/eventId. errorType=3 for auth failure.

rowsets.name: AdHocBulkResult
rowsets.description: Single row confirming the bulk operation.

columns.name: serverMessage
columns.description: 'N records updated, M records inserted, ' — note trailing comma.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.HasherEventMap SET AttendenceState=20, RsvpState=3 — for parsed hashers already at event
INSERT HC.HasherEventMap — for parsed hashers not yet at event
UPDATE HC.Event SET DoTrackHashCash=1 — twice (copy-paste bug, harmless but wasteful)
UPDATE HC.Payment SET CancelledDate — cancels prior payments for all parsed hashers
INSERT HC.Payment — for each hasher (via CURSOR)

codeSmells.detail: All other string parameters in app SPs use NVARCHAR. VARCHAR cannot store Unicode characters, though UUIDs are ASCII-safe.

codeSmells.issue: CURSOR for per-user processing — poor scalability
codeSmells.detail: Each hasher is processed individually in a CURSOR loop with per-iteration SP calls (nonApi_updateKennelCreditByUser). For large bulk operations this will be slow.

codeSmells.issue: No transaction wrapping the bulk operation
codeSmells.detail: HEM upserts, payment cancellations, and payment inserts all run outside a transaction. A failure midway leaves partial state.

codeSmells.issue: UPDATE HC.Event SET DoTrackHashCash=1 executed twice
codeSmells.detail: Copy-paste error — the same UPDATE appears at lines ~199 and ~213. Harmless but wasteful.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change payment type codes without updating all callers
